title: Regions Bank Announces Retirement of Lee Blank, Names Chris Claybrook as Next Nashville Market President
summary: Blank will conclude more than 40 years of serving Regions’ clients and communities at the end of the year, transitioning local leadership to Claybrook. Regions Bank on Wednesday announced Lee Blank , the company’s Nashville Market President and Private Wealth Management Regional Executive for Tennessee, will retire at the end of 2026 following 43 years of service to the bank’s clients and communities. Lee Blank (top, left) will retire after more than 40 years with Regions Bank. And another veteran Regions banker in Nashville, Chris Claybrook (lower, center) will succeed him.
